id: title:brandonleung:start free onboarding sessions on a model both gateways serve

review.posthog_relevance: Updates the default LLM model identifier for PostHog's free-tier onboarding research tasks, potentially affecting compatibility and cost structure for that specific tier.
review.reason: The change replaces a model identifier and its associated tier-specific configuration. This is a localized maintenance and configuration update. While it could theoretically change compatibility or costs, the implementation does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction or a substantive capability improvement across the wider PostHog platform. It is a narrow, bounded change.
review.uncertainty: The actual compatibility and cost implications depend on the underlying model behavior, which is not demonstrated in this code-only review. No production incident or adoption benefit is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Replaces the free-tier onboarding session model identifier from '@cf/zai-org/glm-5.2' to 'zai-org/glm-5.3-flash'.
observations.posthog_connection: Updates the default model used when a free-tier user starts an onboarding research task, potentially changing the underlying LLM and its associated costs or compatibility.
